Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with clinically significant macular edema in at least one eye.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of macular edema or ocular findings in patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Best corrected visual acuity 20/400 or better as measured on an ETDRS chart in the eye with clinically significant macular edema; this eye will be considered the study eye.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data on visual acuity or ocular status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: If both eyes have clinically significant macular edema and best corrected visual acuity greater than or equal to 20/400, the right eye will be considered the study eye.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data on visual acuity or ocular status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: May have had proliferative diabetic retinopathy but scatter photocoagulation must be performed more than six months ago.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of retinopathy or photocoagulation history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ocular media sufficiently clear to allow for quality fundus photography.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data on ocular media clarity.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: If Aphakic or pseudophakic, lens removal must have occurred at least 6 months prior to enrollment.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of aphakia/pseudophakia or lens status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Clinical diagnosis of diabetes based on any one of the criteria (determined by medical physician): Documented history of plasma glucose value greater than 210 mg/dl on 3 different occasions. Fasting blood sugar greater than 150 mg/dl on 3 different occasions. Documented history of ketoacidosis. Insulin dependency. Documented history of abnormal glucose tolerance test.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has Type 2 diabetes with metformin therapy.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient's medical status must include a likelihood of survival for 5 years.
Willingness to accept randomization for diet or drug therapy for lowering of elevated lipid levels.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No explicit statement on willingness to randomize for lipid therapy.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Understand and sign the informed consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients over 18 years of age since the population of interest is primarily older than 18.
A negative urine pregnancy test for women of childbearing potential.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Retinopathy that requires scatter photocoagulation immediately.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of retinopathy or photocoagulation needs.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ocular disease other than diabetic retinopathy that may confound the outcome of the study (e.g. age-related macular degeneration, drug toxicity, uveitis, etc.).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of other ocular diseases.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Had previous focal laser photocoagulation for diabetic macular edema.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of prior laser photocoagulation.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Poor survival due to other systemic diseases (separate from diabetes)
Poor glycemic control with hemoglobin A1C greater than 12 percent.
Past or current liver disease, which precludes the use of the lipid-lowering drugs.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Elevated hepatic transaminases are noted, but no explicit statement on precluding lipid-lowering drugs.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Vitamin E supplementation over and above the amount in a multivitamin (30 IU/day) one month prior to entry into the study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of vitamin E supplementation.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of hypersensitivity to fluorescein.
History of intra-cranial bleeds.
Evidence of other ocular diseases that may confound the assessment of treatment of diabetic macular edema.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of other ocular diseases.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior or current macular detachment in the affected eye(s).
Concurrent celebrex or any other COX-2 inhibitor within 7 days prior to baseline.
Concurrent coumadin therapy or known bleeding diathesis.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of anticoagulants or bleeding diathesis.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent treatment with a new investigational drug.
Concurrent lithium therapy
Malabsorption syndrome.
Concurrent administration of anti-cholesterol resin medications (e.g. cholestyramine) Concurrent administration of the anti-obesity drug orlistat (Xenical).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on atorvastatin, not resins or orlistat.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent administration of other NSAIDs.
Allergy to sulphonomides, NSAIDs, or exhibit the aspirin triad.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of allergies or aspirin triad.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Pregnant or lactating women.
Chronic requirement for any ocular medication for other diseases such as glacoma.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of chronic ocular medications.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Current history of malignancy (except patients having a basal cell carcinoma that was treated successfully, or other malignancy operated on and in remission for 5 years prior to inclusion in the trial).

Recap: Unclear eligibility due to lack of data on macular edema, visual acuity, and liver disease status. Other criteria are met or not violated.
